description.text: Neurology is a discipline in clinical medicine that studies the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases of the central nervous system (brain, spinal cord), peripheral nervous system and skeletal muscles. It is based on basic medical sciences such as neuroanatomy, neurophysiology and neuropathology, and combines imaging techniques (such as cranial MRI and CT), electrophysiological examinations (such as electroencephalogram and electromyography) and molecular biology techniques, focusing on exploring the causes, pathogenesis, clinical manifestations and intervention strategies of neurological diseases. Unlike psychiatry, which focuses on organic neuropathy (such as cerebral infarction and Parkinson's disease), psychiatry pays more attention to psychological and behavioral abnormalities.

duration.text: The Neurology at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1. Non-chinese citizens in good health;2. Degree and age requirementsApplicants to study for a master's degree in China must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 1835 years old;Those who come to China to pursue a doctoral degree must have a master's degree and be no older than the required ageForty years old.3.
